description:
## 2.1.6 (2026-11-21)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **nicoid:** Fix visibly uneven scrolling-comment motion in fullscreen and popup playback even when comment drawing callbacks are running near the configured frame rate
* **nicoid:** Fix excessive comment Canvas processing overhead at larger playback sizes, especially in fullscreen mode, by using hardware-accelerated drawing where supported
* **nicoid:** Prevent comment rendering interruptions and inconsistent presentation when transitioning between normal playback, fullscreen, the in-app mini-player, and popup playback
* **nicoid:** Fix the in-app mini-player's view layout parameters becoming incompatible with their parent after playback view transitions, preventing incorrect sizing and layout failures
* **nicoid:** Fix the app-switch playback preference not changing an existing in-app mini-player or background playback session to popup playback when Popup playback is selected
* **nicoid:** Prevent premature or duplicate popup conversion during app transitions, and avoid launching a popup on screen lock or when the required overlay permission is unavailable
* **nicoid:** Improve continued audio playback with the screen off by retaining the existing foreground media service when Screen-off audio playback is enabled ([#181](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/181))
* **nicoid:** Improve retention of background playback across consecutive videos instead of unexpectedly returning to normal playback ([#122](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/122))
* **nicoid:** Improve recovery from temporary Media3 network failures, including DNS resolution, socket timeouts, and connection errors, without replacing the active media item or playback session
* **nicoid:** Fix the Default playback speed setting showing only its description instead of the currently selected speed
* **nicoid:** Fix fullscreen playback selections being displayed as ordinary playback in certain settings summaries
* **nicoid:** Fix missing or stale selected-value summaries in supported playback, video-quality, startup, history, and display settings

### 🔧 Improvements

* **nicoid:** Accelerate scrolling-comment rendering in normal playback, fullscreen, the in-app mini-player, and popup playback with `Surface.lockHardwareCanvas()` on supported windows
* **nicoid:** Retain the same comment drawing surface when a playback view is moved or resized, and release the owned surface when its `SurfaceTexture` is replaced or destroyed
* **nicoid:** Fall back to the original software Canvas rendering when hardware drawing is unavailable or encounters an error, without changing the video decoder output surface
* **nicoid:** Preserve existing comment movement speed, size, on-screen positions, display lifetime, overlap-prevention behavior, and the configured drawing frame-rate limit while optimizing the drawing pipeline
* **nicoid:** Recheck mini-player view layout compatibility before layout traversal when necessary, while preserving the existing Media3 player, playback queue, and playback position
* **nicoid:** Improve popup handoff reliability with short, bounded retries while retaining the existing background playback session if conversion cannot complete
* **nicoid:** Add bounded Media3 re-preparation attempts for temporary network interruptions without resetting playback position or overriding the user's play/pause intent
* **nicoid:** Show the currently selected value before the descriptions of supported settings, updating the display after preference changes without altering stored preferences or defaults
* **nicoid:** Improve the Japanese, English, and Traditional Chinese descriptions for supported playback and display settings

release_notes:
## 1.9.5 (2026-10-19)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **nicoid:** Fix a crash when changing playback quality.
* **nicoid:** Fix popup player movement bounds.
* **nicoid:** Fix playback controls being positioned outside the visible area in tablet mode. ([#75](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/75))
* **nicoid:** Fix a crash when updating the displayed playback time.

### 🔧 Improvements

* **nicoid:** Improve playback quality switching in normal and popup players. Switch between available video tracks without reloading the stream when supported, while preserving playback position and paused state.
* **nicoid:** Preserve the current playback position and playback state when a stream reload is required for a quality change.
* **nicoid:** Keep user selections synchronized across Nico Report tabs.
* **nicoid:** Improve Google Cast startup diagnostics, including playback request submission and results, to investigate playback remaining on “Preparing.” ([#70](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/70))
